title: Chat: stop splitting vault paths into slash skill tokens
description:
## Why
`tokensFromMessageContent` matches `/[\w][\w-]*/g` per segment, so `/Business/Contracts/MSA.docx` becomes three yellow skill chips (`/Business`, `/Contracts`, `/MSA`) in message bubbles (activity-plane proof).

## Where
- `portal/packages/web/src/features/chat/chatComposerTriggers.ts` — `tokensFromMessageContent`
- Consumers: ChatView / ChatMessageContent / ChatTokenizedText
- Tests: `chatComposerTriggers.test.ts` + bubble render tests

## Design
1. Prefer **path tokens**: consecutive slash segments (incl. dots/extensions) as one token, e.g. `/Business/Contracts/MSA.docx` → single token (same yellow or dedicated file variant).
2. Skill tokens: only isolated `/skill-name` that is NOT followed by another `/segment`.
3. Composer typeahead `/` remains skills; typed multi-segment paths should not open skill menu as successive hits if feasible.
4. Optional: file tokens use distinct variant later; for v1 same highlight family is OK if **one** continuous highlight.

## Acceptance
- Path with 2+ segments = one highlight, not N skill chips
- Real skills like `/summarize` still tokenized
- Unit tests cover path vs skill disambiguation
- Re-screenshot activity-plane / file-ref bubbles
acceptance_criteria: Multi-segment vault paths render as one token; skills still work; tests + screenshot proof
notes: Implemented path-aware slash tokenization (rebased on main). commit=8e2a022844d303233a2e29ab1b7008dd02c92550 PR=https://github.com/LanyardBrain/lanyard-platform/pull/413 Unit tests 10/10 pass. Remaining: UI QA re-screenshot activity-plane/file-ref bubbles (needs_ui_qa).
close_reason: Merged https://github.com/LanyardBrain/lanyard-platform/pull/413 (squash 0bc2b39). Path multi-segment tokens as single yellow highlight; skills still single-segment. Unit tests chatComposerTriggers 11 pass.

title: Portal Agents: model-generated titles + create menu Agent labels
description:
## Why
Post-merge QA of lp-pxr.2: almost every interactive agent is named **Hound** because the offline keyword map treats sales/pipeline language as a fixed codename. That was a bad product substitute for real model naming. User wants the **model** to invent the title after the first user message.

Also create-menu IA: + control should read as **New Agent**; menu items drop the redundant word **New** (Agent / Project / Scheduled Task).

## Not fixed in open PRs
lp-pxr.1–.5 are merged. None of them fix Hound-as-default or create-menu labels.

## Root cause (Hound)
`fixtureAgentNameFromMessage` in `agent-name.ts` maps sales/pipeline/outreach → "Hound". When host `chat.suggest_title` fails or mock returns canned name / falls through, every sales-ish chat becomes Hound.
design:
Naming:
- Bootstrap (create, empty message): always OFFLINE_FIXTURE_EMPTY_NAME / New agent — never keyword map.
- First-message refine: prefer host chat.suggest_title with model; remove product reliance on OFFLINE_CODENAME_RULES keyword map (delete map or reserve for tests only).
- Fixture fallback: neutral hash pool or 'Agent' — not Hound-for-sales.
- Ensure mock/live host path actually generates names when Brain RPC works; document LA must implement suggest_title.

Menu:
- CreateMenuButton button label/tooltip/aria-label: New Agent
- Items: Agent (was New Chat), Project, Scheduled Task
- Update ChatHistorySideNav tests + ui-testing selectors if any
acceptance_criteria:
- [ ] Chat titles after first message come from model suggest_title when host is available
- [ ] Offline/dev never stamps every sales chat as Hound; bootstrap stays generic until first message refine
- [ ] + control labeled New Agent; menu items Agent / Project / Scheduled Task (no New prefix)
- [ ] Tests updated
close_reason: Children merged: #389 naming, #390 create menu.

description:

title: Agents: creative model codenames for chat titles (not prompt word-snippets)
description:
## Why
Generated names today are first few words of the user message (fixtureAgentNameFromMessage) or bland placeholders (\"New agent\"). User wants evocative codenames that fit the *purpose* — e.g. sales pipeline outreach → \"Hound\".

## Current
- portal/packages/bff/src/agent-name.ts: fixtureAgentNameFromMessage takes first clause × 5 words.
- Prefer host Brain RPC chat.suggest_title when enabled; mock gateway returns canned \"Mock Lab Agent\".
- Live: chat titled \"I need a new strategy…\".

## What
- Rewrite suggest_title / assign-name prompt (host path) to request a **short creative agent codename** (1–3 words, no quotes, no sentence, not a paraphrase of the prompt).
- Offline fixture: stop pure word-snippet; prefer a small codename map/heuristic or fixed creative style that is clearly not a prompt excerpt (document limits: offline cannot truly invent without a model).
- When brain RPC returns a name, keep sanitize + max length; never overwrite user|job.
- Tests: fixture no longer equals first-5-words of long sales prompt; host path passes through creative names.

## Note
Real creative quality depends on host model + prompt. Bead owns product-facing contract and BFF prompts/fixtures; LA host tool implementation only if mock/dev path lives here.
design: agent-name.ts, app.ts assign-name, dev-mock-gateway suggest_title, agent-name tests.
acceptance_criteria:
- [ ] Documented name brief: short codename, not prompt excerpt
- [ ] fixtureAgentNameFromMessage (or replacement) does not return first-5-words of a multi-sentence sales prompt as the sole strategy
- [ ] chat.suggest_title prompt (BFF/host) asks for creative codename
- [ ] Unit tests for sanitize + naming policy
notes: PR https://github.com/LanyardBrain/lanyard-platform/pull/385

title: Portal Agents UX polish: dialogs, creative names, config chrome
description:
## Why
Live QA on main (demo.localhost:3010) after lp-lv9 merge. Agents feel closer but five UX gaps remain.

## Live evidence (2026-08-12)
- Agent titles: "I need a new strategy", "New agent" — word-snippet / placeholder, not creative codenames.
- Header single-click opens **inline** "System prompt (purpose)" under the header (not a modal).
- Delete chat uses **window.confirm**.
- Scheduled config pane shell title **Scheduled task** + subtitle **Schedule & instructions**; switch description "Task will fire…"; labels "Instructions" / "Agent instructions".
- Title editor is full-width; commit is Enter-only (no blur-to-save).

## Decisions (user 2026-08-12)
1. Delete chat → Astryx Dialog (meta box) Cancel / Delete — not system confirm.
2. Agent names: model-generated codename fitting the *purpose* (e.g. "Hound"), not first-N-words of the prompt.
3. On scheduled-task create: seed agent purpose/instructions from job instructions; strip redundant pane chrome.
4. Purpose edit: same Dialog pattern as delete; label **Purpose** (not System prompt); Cancel / Save.
5. Rename: ~20ch wide field; blur outside commits (not only Enter).

## Surfaces
portal packages/web (+ bff agent-name / system_prompt seed for scheduled create).
design:
Reuse @astryxdesign/core/Dialog pattern from NewProjectDialog / ShareThreadDialog.
Delete + Purpose dialogs: purpose=form, width ~420, Cancel + primary action.
Naming: improve chat.suggest_title prompt + offline fixture toward short codenames (1–2 words, proper noun vibe); still respect user/job stickiness and sanitize max length.
Scheduled create path: after ensureAgentChatForJob, PATCH system_prompt from cron prompt/instructions when source still default.
Config pane: remove shell title/subtitle noise (or blank title), drop fire helper text, single instructions field without dual labels.
AgentTitleEditor: maxWidth ~20ch (or ch units), onBlur commit.
acceptance_criteria:
- [ ] Delete chat uses Astryx Dialog (no window.confirm for chat delete)
- [ ] Agent names are creative purpose codenames when host/model available; fixture not pure word-snippet
- [ ] Scheduled create seeds Purpose from job instructions; config pane chrome stripped
- [ ] Purpose edit is a Dialog labeled Purpose
- [ ] Rename field compact (~20ch) + blur-to-save
- [ ] Unit tests + light Playwright selectors as needed
close_reason: Children shipped as draft PRs 384–388. Merge to land UX polish.

title: Portal Agents v2: scheduled-ops command center + agent purpose
description:
## Why
Live QA feedback after Agents UI refresh (lp-fn5 / plan 0013): Scheduled Tasks should be the ops command center (not Tools inventory); agent chats need purpose (system prompt) + better naming; Tools chrome should be thinner.

## Decisions (grill-me 2026-08-12)
- Agent model v1: **thread-as-agent** (C) — name, avatar, subtitle, system_prompt on thread; no multi-chat hierarchy
- Scheduled open: **stream-first** (A) — main=run history; config in side pane
- Inventory: **host crons SoT** (A) — ensure stream chat per job; remove Tools Scheduled tasks page
- Status: **composite** (C) — live stream wins; else host last_status; disabled=Off not failed
- Title: **eager name + refine** (B); subtitle=latest-line ellipsis
- System prompt: after **1–2 turns**, small model → ≤10-line purpose; header single-click edits; user ownership sticks
- Config pane: schedule, last/next, status, **slider**, **job instructions** (B); Off=no future fires
- Tools: no section titles; Refresh top-left; drop crons nav
- Folder: **Scheduled Tasks always last**; Plus wizard → ensure under folder + select

## Out of wave
- Multi-chat-per-agent entity
- Wizard that never leaves General orphan (D deferred)
- Full schedule builder in pane
- Model subtitle summaries
- Cancel in-flight on Off
- Dither run animation (optional polish leaf)

## Surfaces
portal packages/web + bff (+ host cron fields as needed). Local verify: demo.localhost:3010 from main.
design:
See conversation grill-me locks. Domain remains ChatThread with kind chat|scheduled_task.
Reuse Activity/Document side pane host for schedule config.
ensureAgentChatForJob / inventory ensure-all on Agents load.
system_prompt + system_prompt_source on thread; inject as prepended purpose block (not vault replace).
acceptance_criteria:
- [ ] Scheduled Tasks folder is last under Agents; lists every host cron (ensured streams)
- [ ] Selecting a job shows run stream + config side pane (schedule, last/next, slider, instructions)
- [ ] Tools has no Scheduled tasks section; titleless sections with Refresh top-left
- [ ] Agent title eager+refine; subtitle ellipsis; system prompt after 1–2 turns + header editor
- [ ] Status dots composite + explicit Off; unit + Playwright proofs
close_reason: Children shipped as draft PRs 375–381 (+8,9). Merge stack to complete product integration.
